verdict.rationale: The IRS runs machine channels (MeF's XML system-to-system rail and the IRIS A2A intake), so an API reference is a fair question here. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples. All OpenAPI/Swagger probes returned 404, and the documented machine channels are credentialed rails rather than an explorable public reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
